metadata.title: Multiplication Table
metadata.description: Print the n-times table for rows 1..n with a for loop over range(1, n + 1).

instructions.main: Set `n = 5` and print the 5-times table, one row per line: `5 x 1 = 5` through `5 x 5 = 25`.
steps: Loop `i` over `range(1, n + 1)` so every row from 1 to n is printed.
Print each row as `n x i = n * i`.

hints.message: Start with `n = 5` and a `for i in range(1, n + 1):` loop.
`range(1, n)` stops before n — the last row is missing. Use `range(1, n + 1)`.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: Your multiplication table prints every row from 1 to n.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: All five rows print exactly as required.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Print every row from `5 x 1 = 5` to `5 x 5 = 25` — check the range end.

test_cases.feedback_on_pass: You loop with range over two bounds.
test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Use a `for` loop with `range(start, stop)` to generate the rows.
